import sys

    n = len(p)
    inversions = 0
    max_inversions = 0
    max_index = -1
    
    for i in range(n):
        if p[i] > max_inversions:
            max_inversions = p[i]
            max_index = i
        else:
            inversions += max_inversions - p[i]
    
    if inversions == 0:
        return 0
    elif inversions == 1:
        return 1
